source.title: [Season 16] BodyThoseFools' Challenger Azir Guide [In-depth] (10,000,000+ Mastery Points) (Beat Faker)

fields: Respect his E-Q repositioning, though his E has a long cooldown early. An early Oblivion Orb helps against his passive and ult healing. If his W tethers you, move sideways or use W-E-Q or E-Q to escape so you do not take the big hit or burn Flash. From level 6, ult him away when he ults, or E-Q back to your tower.

You outrange her, so harass with soldier autos constantly. Dodge her Q return (true damage) and above all her charm, using minions as cover; watch for a level 1 W trade. Cleanse is an option if their team has lots of hard CC. After level 6 her dashes give more kill threat, but if she dashes close you can ult her into your tower before she can recast.

Use your range to poke her whenever possible. Do not fight her inside shroud; back off and wait for it to end since it has a long cooldown. After level 6 a misused Q or E can get you killed, so track your cooldowns. You can ult her out of shroud into your tower, and a perfectly timed ult can even stop her second R.

Never trade autos inside his range, as his double shot wins early trades, and dodge his Q to deny his shield. Farm until Lost Chapter, then poke with Hail of Blades or Comet from outside his range. Ping when he goes invisible since he roams or cheeses you if you are pushed up. Stand behind minions or an active turret to block his ult; a tier 2 turret does not block while the tier 1 still stands.

Dodge her Q and she has no kill threat. Lethal Tempo can work for killing her after her egg pops, and Comet pokes well from max range. A good Anivia uses her wall to keep the wave on her side, forcing you to walk up into gank range; her wall can also cancel your E-Q dash.

Outrange and poke her, but do not trade when her passive is at four stacks or the stun will cost you heavy damage or Cleanse. Buy an early Null-Magic Mantle after Lost Chapter to survive her combo. Take Cleanse if you are unsure of your spacing or their team has more hard CC.
Kite his W and sidestep or E out of his Q. Poke him down before going all-in, and keep him pushed in so he cannot roam; ping your team when he goes missing.
You outrange him. Sidestep his W and stay away from a wave he has set ablaze, since his E can spread to you. His ult bouncing back to stun you makes all-ins risky, so poke him low before committing.

Freeze near your turret until you have a clear lead, because if you are pushed up she will E onto you; this lets you poke her safely when she farms. Dodge her W to avoid the heal and slow, and watch for her E bouncing off your wall. Hold your ult until after she ults, since hers makes her untargetable and yours then lets you escape her zone.

Use your range to poke her down. Her W stops your E-Q dash, so be careful using it near Miasma. If you dodge her Qs she has no kill threat, and you can bait her ult by standing still and turning away as the animation starts.
Dodging his Q is mandatory or you get chunked. Stay out of W range and poke him. Once he has level 6 and Everfrost, a single landed Q can mean death.

Very easy; he needs Fleet Footwork, Doran's Shield and Second Wind just to survive. Q plus auto him every time he goes for a minion and dodge his Qs. He struggles to farm until level 6, and once he has the Package he can threaten you, so dash away, Flash or Zhonya's his Package.

He cannot reach you without Flash-E or Ghost, so dash away and wait those out. His Doran's Shield plus Second Wind sustain is annoying, but keep poking when he farms and freeze just outside your turret. When ahead, dash onto him or away to avoid his Q heal; if he pulls you, place a soldier opposite him and E-Q away. Simply not dying makes him irrelevant later, so play to scale.

If you dodge her Q she can do little, so poke her afterward. When she all-ins, ult her away right as she ults to avoid the second hit. After level 6, once she Qs minions, beware her E chain into ult to set up ganks.

Dodge his cleavers and watch your minions' health, since his E can knock them into you. If their team has lots of healing, buy an early Oblivion Orb. His passive makes your ult useless, so use Flash or E to escape. He is nearly unkillable until you have an item or two, so focus on farming.

Use your range against the melee Ekko and dodge his Q so he cannot proc his passive damage and slow. Harass him after he spends Q or E on farm. Watch for W cast from a bush, and after level 6 ult him under your tower when he all-ins.

A spacing-heavy matchup; she may wait in the brush near your tower at level 1 and all-in, so you might have to skip the first wave. Move away to swap a front vital to a back one and hug walls to protect vitals. Dodge her riposte, which slows your attack speed heavily. After level 6 dash away from her ult chase, and only ult her after she spends riposte or she can stun you.

Bully him heavily before level 6 while staying out of Q range. Hold your ult until after he uses E or he will hop over it. You can bait his ult by placing a soldier behind you, walking at him and E-Qing back when he fires; many Fizz players ult on cooldown.
Neither of you can kill the other early without mistakes, so you scale freely. Push him in to limit roams; match his roams if your wave allows, otherwise ping your team and take plates.

Your range and attack speed mean he cannot barrel you, and two soldiers hit two barrel ticks. Farm his barrels and poke him, staying away from brush where he can surprise you. When he tries to Q, drop a soldier on him and auto with Hail of Blades, or stay at max range with Comet.

One of the easiest top lanes; he only reaches you with Flash or Ghost. Walk or dash away from his Q, and if he Flash-Qs into range, ult him away before the silence lands. Freeze near your turret and harass constantly so he loses CS, then scale and group.

Fairly easy. Dodge his boomerang slow and do not fight him while Mega, since he can stun you and leave. After level 6 avoid engaging when his rage is full or nearly full, and if he hops onto you, ult him away and dash out if needed.

Dodge his barrel poke and stay behind minions to block his body slam. His passive sustain makes poking him out difficult. Wait out his W damage reduction before poking, and avoid long trades or he will ult you toward his turret or barrels.
You outrange him and his E passive does little against you. Step out of his Q line, walk or E out of his smoke, and Flash or W-E out of his ult. Use minions, allies and turrets to block his autos.

Strongly favors you due to range. At level 1 she may hide in the brush near your tower with E, so avoid trading autos then. Do not fight her inside her W, where she gains resistances and you cannot hit her from outside; wait for it to drop. After level 6 freeze near your turret and look to shuffle her under it; dash away if she uses Ghost to chase.

Clear his level 1 turrets with soldiers so he cannot shove you under tower. Sidestep his rockets or hide behind minions, and you must dodge his grenade or you will be stunned and chunked. Only all-in when his E is on cooldown.

Easy as long as you dodge her tentacles and especially her E, which can force you out of lane or kill you. Getting hit by Qs lets her heal off your poke. After level 6 she is unstoppable during her ult and can ult through yours, but she has no way to reach Azir, so keep using your range.

Very volatile. Tell your jungler and support that she will play aggressively so you can punish her repeatedly. Watch low-health minions she can Q through, never trade into stacked passive, and freeze on your side while she tries to freeze at hers. Dodge her E and Flash or dash from her ult; ult her during a Q to deny the reset.

He may wait in the brush near your tower at level 1 to cheese you and deny the first minions. With good spacing you can poke him freely despite his jumps. After level 6 ult him away or toward your turret when he leaps in. Void Staff as your second or third item helps against his ult resistances.

A good Jayce pokes from off-screen with Q-E, so use minions as cover without standing too close to them. In hammer form he can Q onto caster minions and hit you with the area, so keep away from them. Use your early range before he gets items, and after level 6 ult him into your tower when he hammer-Qs you.

Rare but very tough, especially top. She is strong early but falls off, so play to scale: freeze near your turret until you have an item or two, poke with Q plus auto and back off to avoid long Rend trades, and dodge her Q that passes through killed minions. After level 6 she will likely bind to her jungler and throw them at you, so be ready to dash away; ult her away when she hops in.

She lacks kill pressure, so you scale freely. Dodge her empowered Qs and farm to Lost Chapter, since her shields cancel your early poke. If she uses empowered W on you, E out of range to avoid the root and heal.

If he takes Exhaust, all-ins are hard unless he is already low. His Q range is similar to yours, so trade from inside your minions or be ready to dodge. Zhonya's or Banshee's Veil can negate his ult; disengage from his wall, which lowers your magic resist, and stay out of his E aura.

He cannot farm comfortably against your poke before level 6; harass when his Q is down or from max range. After 6, E away when he ults in, or ult him into your tower when near it. The lane only turns if he gets early kills, so ban him if your team lacks CC or has several AP threats.

Use your range and stay clear of her daggers. If she all-ins, ult her away or into your turret, ideally saving your ult to cancel hers. Push her under tower to limit roams and ping loudly when she goes missing; it only becomes hard if she gets early kills.
A free lane; before level 6 she has no threat. Harass her every time she goes for CS, and freeze to zone her if you can. If she ults, push her away to avoid the damage.
You outrange him; dodge his shuriken or hide behind minions. If he ults you, ult him away, Zhonya's or dash out. In teamfights, push him off your team when he ults, and all-in once he is poked low.

Cut Down is useful because of his high health pool. Focus on dodging his Q, which he likes to hide behind his E animation. Poke him relentlessly; once dismounted, your harass makes remounting hard. After level 6, wait until after his ult hits you before ulting him away, since he is unstoppable during it.

An AP Kog'Maw has the range to contest you, so dodge his spells and Q-auto him between cooldowns and when he farms. His wide E slightly outranges you and sets up his Q and ult, so avoid it. Wait out his W window rather than trading. He is immobile, so get your jungler to burn his Flash, then shuffle him for kills.

A spacing matchup; at level 1 she looks to auto-W-auto for Electrocute. Comet lets you poke with Q-auto from just outside her W range and walk away. Do not let her Q-W free, dodge her chain at all costs, and you can ult her during her W to avoid its damage. Play aggressively if her jungler farms and carefully if they gank; freeze at your tower and ping her roams.

Dodge her Q, which gains range after hitting a target near your minions. She is predictable: an E toward you means she is committing, often for a gank. Poke her with Q-auto, and take Cleanse if unsure or if their team has heavy CC.

You outrange him, but at level 1 he may dash past your soldier to proc Press the Attack. Let him push early and freeze near your turret; after Lost Chapter you can poke without mana issues. He will trade after you use Q, so back off when he walks at you. E out of his ult unless you can interrupt it with your ult; Exhaust is an option, and you outscale him.

Dodge her E and especially her Q, which can cost you Flash or your life; Cleanse is an option. Farm to Lost Chapter, then poke repeatedly. From level 6 you can all-in when she misses Q around half health. Banshee's Veil helps against her snare, and Zhonya's helps against her ult and other big ults.

His Q poke hurts, so use range and keep harassing to strip his passive shield. From level 6 he will look to ult you with his jungler, so be ready to Flash. Do not ult until he lands since he is unstoppable, and his ground slow cuts your attack speed if you all-in.

Easy: outrange and harass him with Q-auto. He has little kill threat before level 6 and needs help even after. Sidestep his silence, which also interrupts your E-Q, and remember his E resets if hit by Q or R. Your autos one-shot his voidlings; once he is poked, all-in with E-Q-R.

Dodge his E and Q and he has no kill pressure; bait his E by faking a last hit. His early cooldowns are long, so poke hard with your range. After level 6 he only kills you with Flash-ult, and even then you can ult him away and E-Q to outlast it; soldiers and your wall do not follow into the Death Realm.

With Doran's Shield, Second Wind, his lifesteal passive and Fleet Footwork, your early poke barely matters, and his Wither counters you. After level 6 he will Ghost-Wither to kill you, so disengage with E-Q. Freeze near your tower, farm until you have an item or two, and invite your jungler to punish him early.
Dodge her Q and especially her root, which gains range when it passes through a minion. Leave her Q area quickly since it can pop repeatedly. If she ults you, ult her away or dash out.

He is very strong early, so do not trade autos; freeze near your turret and poke when he farms. Sidestep his axe or dash away from its slow. He gains damage and lifesteal at low health, so be careful all-inning while his W is up. His ult makes him unstoppable and immune to your ult push, but your wall cast backward can block his path if he lacks Flash.
Practically free: her early game is very weak and you slightly outrange her. After level 6 stay away from her ball to avoid the ult; if quick you can dash or Flash out of it.

Annoying because he is so tanky. Dodge his Qs and poke with your range; First Strike works well since he cannot hit you unless you walk into Q. After level 6 E-Q or Flash out of his ult. His W is unstoppable and his knockups can cancel your dash or break your wall; try to ult him before his second R cast.

Free if you keep spacing; he cannot engage without Flash. Stand behind minions to soften his Q and do not waste spells into his frontal shield. Get Lost Chapter and keep poking, ping his roams since he plays for his ult, and a quick ult can cancel his W.

Tanky and able to engage by E-ing off minions, much like Ornn but more aggressive. Her W blocks your dash, so hold E until it ends. Walk away when her passive buckler is ready and do not poke into her shield. After level 6 ult her away or toward your turret if she E's onto you, and dodge her ult in fights unless you want it as an escape.

Annoying but winnable thanks to range; Exhaust is an option. Poke her hard at level 1 when she has little reach. Later dodge her Qs, stay away from walls and your own turret to avoid ult stuns, and beware she can ult your wall for a stun. Perfect Timing in Inspiration and Zhonya's as your second item are recommended; avoid fighting her in chokes and near river.

Respect her level 1 power spike, avoid early damage and farm to Lost Chapter, after which your range wins the lane. Dodge her Q blind, ping her roams at level 6, and hold your dash until she uses her vault since she can interrupt it.

His sustain and double dash are annoying; do not approach the wave when he has more than half fury. After level 6 ult him away. Like Darius, staying alive makes him weak later, so farm and group. Spacing matters even more if he buys Prowler's Claw.

Very hard. Freeze near your turret permanently and avoid brush, since he will leap on you if you push. Save cooldowns until he uses empowered W to heal, and dodge his bola. A perfectly timed ult or Zhonya's can negate his ult leap, or push him into your tower.

She may cheese you from brush at level 1 and deny early minions. Stay out of her range and poke while her Q is on cooldown. After level 6, especially with Flash, she can kill you, so ult her away or E-Q/Flash out.

You outrange him, but poor spacing around level 3 can get you one-shot; Exhaust is an option. His W shield and sustain shrug off early poke. Dodge his harpoons, avoid fighting him above half heat and never trade autos while he is overheated. Ult him into your tower if he overextends, dash out of his ult, ping his roams, and you outscale at two items.
Outrange and poke him early. His waveclear improves after Tear and Lost Chapter. Avoid standing near a wave he E's to prevent spread damage, and respect his Flash-E-W gank setup with his jungler.

Her long range lets her contest you, so dodge her Q and double Q, and watch double E setting up her ult. You have the edge, and after Lost Chapter and Luden's she cannot keep up with your poke. Her ult extends through champions, so position for it in fights or keep Flash.

He may cheese from brush at level 1 with E. Afterward he cannot reach you without Flash if you space well; kite back during his Q speed. Farm and scale through his sustain. After level 6 ult only after landing from his unstoppable ult, sidestep the true damage center of his W, and wait out his E so it does not cancel your dash.

Pretty free since you outrange him; he only reaches you with Flash or a taunt you walk into. His W does not block soldier autos, but respect early taunt all-ins and his ability to taunt you under his turret. Ping his level 6 to your team and try to dash onto and ult him to cancel his channel.

Easy since he has no dashes. Freeze to make him overextend, and guard your jungle at level 1 to stop a proxy. In mid he will shove and roam, so warn your team. His W grounds you so you cannot dash; ult him at max range or his flip still lands, and disengage from his ult.

Similar to Ornn: avoid his E and walk out of his Q, watching brush for early Q cheese. Cut Down or First Strike are good picks. Poke off his W shield or walk away when it is up. E or E-Q out of his ult, or let him ram into your wall.

Very easy; his Q is short ranged, so do not walk into it. Sidestep his E and W to avoid losing trades. Poke and all-in when he is low; after level 6 E or ult him away or into your tower when he ults. Ignite helps against his ult healing, or take Teleport and hold an Oblivion Orb.

He often trades aggressively at level 1 with E or starts Q to farm. Dodge his chain at all costs; ult him only as his second E hits, or he will pull through it. Freeze at your tower and use range. Ignite counters his W healing, though Teleport with Oblivion Orb also works.

A dodging contest; avoid her Qs or you lose lane, and sometimes stepping forward catches predictive Qs. Track her spheres to avoid or bait her stun. Get an early Null-Magic Mantle, Mercury's Treads or Banshee's Veil to survive her burst. All-in only after her E is down, and poke when her Q is on cooldown.

Rare but very annoying; dodge his tongue or the slow sets up his knockup. Your E cooldown is shorter than his W, so react quickly to E out of his dive. First Strike works well. After level 6, ult him away whenever he dives you.

Her early game is weaker now, but do not take free Qs; moving in one direction dodges them. Poke with Q-auto and Comet. Never dash through her minefield, and focus on dodging her W knockback, which sets up her combo. Ping her roams, especially at level 6.

He only kills you if both halves of his W land; the return is easier to dodge. Buy Seeker's Armguard if unsure or if he snowballed. He can vault over your wall. Poke him and push him in to limit roams.

Easy, but watch for him waiting stealthed outside turret range at level 1. Space well and bully him; his blind does not affect your soldiers. After Lost Chapter the lane is simple, though watch his shrooms after level 6.

Play very safe early since she may jump on you at level 1 if she starts W. Her E passive prevents her from freezing, so freeze near your tower and poke with Q plus Hail of Blades or Comet. If she jumps in, auto with Hail of Blades then Q-E out. After Lost Chapter poke consistently; after level 6 ult her into your tower if she jumps aggressively.

His sustain makes him hard to poke out, and he may try to crit you down at level 1, so stay back. Watch his fury bar and fake running to bait his slow. E away from pre-6 all-ins, and after level 6 ult him away as he dives so his undying times out, tracking its duration on his HUD. If he flees, chase with soldiers or a dash.

You outrange him and his cards are easy to dodge; stand away from minions hit by red card. After Lost Chapter keep him pushed in to limit ult roams, and ping when he goes missing. Respect gold card ganks with his jungler, and Cleanse is an option.

He may cheese from a bush with E, so be alert. Dodge his Qs, back off or ult him away when he looks to E you, and Flash or E-Q out of his ult. Recall when low rather than risking it; you outscale him.

Do not trade autos with her early, as she out-damages you; freeze near your turret and farm until Lost Chapter, after which your range wins. Back off when she has a tumble-empowered auto ready, ult or dash away from her ult chase, and stay away from walls, remembering she can Flash after a buffered Condemn.

Harass with Q-auto and Comet to deny free stacks, and dodge his Q and W. Freeze near your tower since he is gankable without E. All-in with ult once he is around half health, but only after he uses his cage or while he is mid-cast. If he runs Predator, warn your team and walk away when he uses it, as Predator plus Everfrost is his main way to reach you.
A dodging lane like Syndra. Walk out of his split Q or step forward unexpectedly. Poke with Q-auto and Comet and all-in when he is low or misses his E. You can E out of his ult.

You outrange her and her spells are slow to dodge; poke with Q-auto and Comet. When her passive is full, avoid every spell or you will be feared, and note it triggers on your Flash or E. Ult her away when she ults you, and an early Null-Magic Mantle prevents one-shots.

His E is hard to sidestep but low damage early; bait it by faking a last hit. If he starts Q, stay out of his auto-Q-auto range. He lacks waveclear until 100 passive stacks, so poke him hard, especially after Lost Chapter, and gank him with your jungler. Get distance from his ult storm, and beware his W and ult after you E-Q in.

You outrange him but his sustain is annoying. Avoid him when his empowered Q is ready and stay behind minions to dodge his E. E-Q and Ignite him when low to force pool, which costs him health. Dash away from his ult; you cannot push him while he is in pool. Lost Chapter makes the lane much easier.

Easy: harass with Q-auto and walk or E-Q away from his Q charge. Dodge his lightning strike, which slows you and sets up engages. From level 6 he can disable your tower, but you can ult him away after he lands. First Strike works since he cannot avoid its proc.

His sustain is annoying; Ignite or an early Oblivion Orb help. Do not try to poke him out before Lost Chapter or you will run out of mana. He heals more at low health and loves to bait with it, especially with Barrier. A well-timed ult can push him away after his ult lands, since your wall spawns behind you.

Space him and stay out of E range. His W dash can let him escape your ult, so time it carefully. Freeze near your turret so he must overextend, and harass as he farms. Anticipate his E with your ult, and ult or E away when he ults.

A dodging lane: easy if you can dodge, very hard if you cannot. Early boots, Taste of Blood or Biscuits help. Never let him auto you, since that restores his mana. Sidestep his stun and only engage when it is down and he is low. He is immobile, so set up ganks, and vary your movement to be less predictable.

Favors Azir thanks to range. Let him push and freeze near your tower; if you push or he freezes, he will dash through minions and run you down. Avoid him at levels 1-2 with Lethal Tempo, and W-E to dodge his tornado. Experienced players will Wind Wall your Q and ult; if he E-Qs to knock you up, ult at the same moment so he cannot follow with his ult.

Doran's Shield and Second Wind make him hard to poke out. Back off or sidestep his Q3 tornado, and Q-E away from his E engage. Time your ult so it lands after his ult blink, not before. Poke during his long E cooldown, and sidestep or Zhonya's his ult.

Dodge his E or get chunked; you can E out of his cage once it forms. After level 6 his Maiden spawns ghouls from dying minions. Use multiple soldiers to break the cage, and kill ghouls with regular autos since they resist area damage; they and the Maiden give gold.

Dodge his shurikens to stay out of all-in range, and punish during his long W cooldown or when he uses Q to farm. Freeze at your tower to weaken his W all-ins. After level 6 buffer your ult to knock him away or into your tower as he lands behind you. Early Seeker's Armguard, the Inspiration Stopwatch, and Zhonya's all counter him.
Dodge his bouncing Q. Do not roam without strong priority, since he can melt and execute your tower and you lose map pressure if mid tower falls. His W can cancel your dash if timed well.

Dodge her Q and E or get poked out; she likes to hide Q in fog, so hug the opposite side of the lane and stay clear of minions. She often ults over your wave to land E, so Cleanse is an option. When poked and overextended, you know where her ult returns her, so dash there and ult her; experienced Zoes can dodge your ult with hers. Vary your movement.
